cause: The Windows working tree retained CRLF copies after the byte-preservation attribute was added, while the committed package blobs and raw candidate hashes were LF. The raw-only audit correctly rejected the mismatched source bytes.
recovery: Rewrote the 15 tracked package files from their exact HEAD blobs with git cat-file. git ls-files --eol then showed i/lf and w/lf for the frozen cases, sources, and manifest; all four auditor tests passed against the same retained raw outputs.
scope: Checkout-byte integrity only. No candidate rerun, formal allocation retry, X11, game, model, GUI, GPU, OS input, or shared-container use.
